Minute Entry for proceedings held before Magistrate Judge Lisa J. Cisneros: Telephonic Pre-Settlement Conference held on 5/21/2025.Total Time in Court: 7 minutes. Court Reporter: Not Recorded. Plaintiff Attorney: John Hemann and Patrick Northup, Cooley LLP, counsel for Plaintiff.Defendant Attorney: Benjamin I. Fink, Berman Fink Van Horn P.C. and Aidan Chowning Poppler, Chan Punzalan LLP, counsel for Defendants.Results: The parties updated Judge Cisneros regarding their efforts to determine whether a global settlement conference would be possible. The parties plan to hold a global settlement conference with a private mediator in Georgia. Accordingly, the Court will release the current dates that are being held for a settlement conference with Judge Cisneros. In the future, the parties may contact Judge Cisneros's Courtroom Deputy, if they wish to reschedule a settlement conference with her. Minute Entry for proceedings held before Magistrate Judge Lisa J. Cisneros: Telephonic Pre-Settlement Conference held on 5/15/2025. Total Time in Court: 28 minutes. Court Reporter: Not Recorded. Plaintiff Attorney: John Hemann and Patrick Northup, Cooley LLP, counsel for Plaintiff. Defendant Attorney: Benjamin I. Fink, Berman Fink Van Horn P.C. and Margo Crawford, Chan Punzalan LLP, counsel for Defendant. Results: Judge Cisneros discussed with counsel the posture of the case and related litigation, and provided potential dates for a settlement conference. Counsel agreed that further discussions between counsel and the litigants are necessary to determine the scope and timing for the settlement conference. Judge Cisneros and counsel will reconvene for another pre-settlement conference call on May 21, 2025, at 9:00 am. The Court will reserve July 25 and 28, 2025 for a full day, in-person settlement conference, and on May 21st the settlement conference date will be set. Settlement conferences generally start at 10:00 am.(bns, COURT STAFF) (Date Filed: 5/15/2025) (Entered: 05/15/2025)
